activity_summary: At grey first light the sheet was half filled. A wad of clove-wool sat in a saucer by the inkhorn. The cloves had stopped answering yesterday. The wool was still there.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote on, and did not clear the saucer.

entities.name: the clove-wool
entities.context: Mentioned in Grey light, half the sheet

facets.activity: Saw the clove-wool by the inkhorn
